page_title: functools — Higher-order functions and operations on callable objects

sources.entry: functools - (Python standard library) Higher-order functions and operations on callable objects.

summary.name: functools
summary.one_liner: Python standard library module providing higher-order function tools such as caching decorators, partial application, single-dispatch generics, and comparison helpers.
use_cases: Caching results of expensive or recursive functions
Pre-filling some arguments of a function with partial application
Dispatching function implementations by argument type
Generating comparison methods for a class from one or two ordering methods
Converting old-style comparison functions into sort keys
Caching a computed instance property once per object
summary.what_it_does: The module provides decorators and helpers for functions that operate on other functions. cache and lru_cache memoize results keyed on arguments, with lru_cache supporting a maxsize limit and cache_info/cache_clear helpers. cached_property computes a value once per instance and stores it as a normal attribute. partial and partialmethod freeze some arguments of a callable, and Placeholder reserves positional slots. singledispatch and singledispatchmethod route calls to different implementations based on the type of the first argument, while total_ordering fills in missing rich comparison methods. It also includes reduce, cmp_to_key for sort keys, and update_wrapper for writing decorators.
notable: lru_cache and cache memoize function results, with thread-safe caches
singledispatch dispatches on argument type with support for type annotations and typing.Union
partial supports Placeholder sentinels to fill arguments in any position (Python 3.14+)
cached_property is a per-instance cached property that can be cleared by deleting the attribute
caveats: cache requires Python 3.9+, cached_property requires 3.8+, and Placeholder requires 3.14+
Caches keep references to arguments and return values until evicted or cleared; arguments must be hashable for lru_cache
cached_property does not prevent multiple getter runs under threading and does not work with classes lacking a mutable __dict__
